heading: Post-Quantum-Resistant
content: Every connection uses hybrid ML-KEM-768 + X25519 key exchange, so records that must stay private for decades are protected against harvest-now, decrypt-later attacks.

heading: 4-Layer Encryption
content: Data is protected in transit, during computation, on the ledger and at rest. Each layer assumes the one before it has already failed.

heading: Final in One Pass
content: Leaderless aBFT consensus gives deterministic finality: no reorgs, no front-running, and no single leader to attack or censor.

heading: An L2 for Every Customer
content: Each institution gets its own L2 with its own policies, privacy and bridge, and blocks resize with load. Every L2 settles to one shared record.

heading: Account Abstraction
content: Users never handle seed phrases or gas tokens, and apps can pay the fees. One face scan to pay, and a lost phone is not a lost wallet.

heading: Connects to Anything
content: Bridges and SDKs reach EVM chains, Solana, Sui, bank DLTs and APIs. No lock-in, shared liquidity.
